tissues.q: What part of speech is TISSUES in: 'Mom packed tissues in my backpack.'?
tissues.hint: The answer is "plural noun". Tissues names more than one thing, so it is a plural noun.

tissues.q: Which word is a plural noun?
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". Tissues names more than one tissue; lullaby is singular and examine is a verb.

tissues.q: A plural noun names more than one thing. Which word in 'I grabbed two soft tissues' is a plural noun?
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". Tissues names more than one thing.

tissues.q: Which word is a plural noun, just like TISSUES?
tissues.hint: The answer is "buttons". Buttons and tissues both name more than one thing.

tissues.q: What are TISSUES?
tissues.hint: The answer is "thin, soft papers". Tissues are thin and soft so you can wipe your nose.

tissues.q: What would you do with TISSUES?
tissues.hint: The answer is "blow your nose". Tissues are soft papers for wiping your nose.

tissues.q: Where would you most likely find TISSUES?
options: in a box near the sink
tissues.hint: The answer is "in a box near the sink". People keep tissue boxes in bathrooms and classrooms.

tissues.q: 'Grab some tissues, I'm sneezing!' What are tissues used for here?
tissues.hint: The answer is "wiping a runny nose". When you sneeze, you wipe your nose with tissues.

tissues.q: Which word best describes how TISSUES feel?
tissues.hint: The answer is "soft". Tissues are thin and soft.

tissues.q: Which of these is most like TISSUES?
tissues.hint: The answer is "paper napkins". Paper napkins are also thin, soft papers.

tissues.q: Sara had a cold and used lots of ____.
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". When you have a cold, you use tissues.

tissues.q: Which sentence uses TISSUES correctly?
options: The tissues roared in the jungle.
We rode the tissues to the farm.
Our teacher keeps a box of tissues on her desk.
tissues.hint: The answer is "Our teacher keeps a box of tissues on her desk.". Tissues come in a box; you cannot ride them or hear them roar.

tissues.q: Which word fits: The sad movie made Dad cry, so Mom handed him some ____.
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". Tissues help wipe away tears.

tissues.q: Please throw your used ____ in the trash can.
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". You throw away tissues after you use them.

tissues.q: Which word fits: Ben's nose was runny all day, so he kept a pack of ____ in his pocket.
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". A runny nose needs tissues.

tissues.q: Which is the correct spelling?
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". Tissues has two s's after the i.

tissues.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence: 'Can I have some ____?'
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". Tissues is t-i-s-s-u-e-s.

tissues.q: Fill the missing letters: ti_su_s
tissues.hint: The answer is "s and e". The word is t-i-s-s-u-e-s.

tissues.q: Which spelling is right for soft papers for your nose?
tissues.hint: The answer is "tissues". Tissues ends with u-e-s.

marlin.q: What part of speech is MARLIN in: 'The fisherman saw a marlin jump.'?
marlin.hint: The answer is "noun". Marlin names an animal, so it is a noun.

marlin.q: A word that names an animal or thing is a noun. Which kind of word is MARLIN?
marlin.hint: The answer is "noun". A marlin is a fish, and animals are nouns.

marlin.q: Which word is a noun?
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". Marlin names a fish; beneath is a preposition and proclaim is a verb.

marlin.q: In 'A huge marlin swam past our boat,' which word is a noun?
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". Marlin names the fish; huge describes it and swam is the action.

marlin.q: Which word is the same part of speech as MARLIN?
marlin.hint: The answer is "kelp". Marlin and kelp are both nouns.

marlin.q: What is a MARLIN?
options: a big ocean fish with a long pointed nose
marlin.hint: The answer is "a big ocean fish with a long pointed nose". A marlin is a big fish with a spear-like nose.

marlin.q: Where would you find a MARLIN?
marlin.hint: The answer is "in the ocean". Marlins are ocean fish.

marlin.q: Which body part makes a MARLIN easy to spot?
marlin.hint: The answer is "its long, pointed nose". A marlin has a long, spear-like nose.

marlin.q: Which animal is most like a MARLIN?
marlin.hint: The answer is "a swordfish". A swordfish is also a big ocean fish with a long pointed nose.

marlin.q: 'We saw a marlin leap out of the water.' What did we see?
marlin.hint: The answer is "a big fish". A marlin is a big fish that can jump out of the water.

marlin.q: Which of these could be a MARLIN?
options: a large blue fish with a spear-like nose
a green frog on a log
a tiny goldfish in a bowl
marlin.hint: The answer is "a large blue fish with a spear-like nose". Marlins are large fish with spear-like noses.

marlin.q: The fishing boat chased a giant ____ across the ocean.
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". A giant ocean fish is a marlin.

marlin.q: Which sentence uses MARLIN correctly?
options: I wrote a letter with my marlin.
The marlin swam fast through the deep blue sea.
The marlin climbed up the oak tree.
marlin.hint: The answer is "The marlin swam fast through the deep blue sea.". A marlin is a fish that swims in the sea.

marlin.q: Which word fits: At the aquarium, we saw a big fish with a nose like a spear. It was a ____.
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". A big fish with a spear-like nose is a marlin.

marlin.q: Out on the ocean, a ____ jumped high out of the waves.
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". A marlin is an ocean fish that jumps out of the waves.

marlin.q: Which word fits: Grandpa's favorite ocean fish has a long, pointed nose. It is the ____.
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". The ocean fish with a pointed nose is the marlin.

marlin.q: Which is the correct spelling?
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". Marlin is m-a-r-l-i-n.

marlin.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence: 'We saw a ____ in the sea.'?
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". Marlin has one r and ends in -lin.

marlin.q: Fill the missing letters: m_rl_n
marlin.hint: The answer is "a and i". The word is m-a-r-l-i-n.

marlin.q: Which spelling is right for the big ocean fish with a pointed nose?
marlin.hint: The answer is "marlin". Marlin starts with mar and ends with lin.
